description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2007 World Championships, led by Flygon ex δ, which has no Weakness, with Jolteon ex, Vaporeon ex and Absol ex to answer different opponents. The 2007 World Championships were held at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Waikoloa Village, Hawaii, from 10 to 12 August 2007.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2007 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
